    # ---- model --------------------------------------------------------
    mranges = {"classes": (2, 8), "embedding_dim": (1, 4), "kernel": (1, 5)}
    for key, (lo, hi) in mranges.items():
        for v in (lo - 1, hi + 1):
            expect_error("model %s=%d" % (key, v), _mdl(BASE, {key: v}),
                         failures)
        for v in (lo, hi):
            if key == "kernel" and v > BASE["config"]["window"]:
                expect_error("model kernel>W", _mdl(BASE, {"kernel": v}), failures)
            else:
                expect_ok("model %s=%d" % (key, v),
                          _mdl(BASE, {key: v,
                                     "conv_weights": _cw(v, 2, 2)}), failures)
    # kernel vs window
    expect_error("kernel>window", _cfg(_mdl(BASE, {"kernel": 4,
                                                   "conv_weights": _cw(4, 3, 2)}), {}),
                 failures)
    expect_ok("kernel==window",
              _mdl(BASE, {"kernel": 3, "conv_weights": _cw(1, 3, 2)}), failures)

    for key in ("length_embedding", "gap_embedding", "conv_weights",
                "conv_bias", "conv_shift", "dense_weights", "dense_bias",
                "classes", "embedding_dim", "kernel"):
        expect_error("model missing " + key, _mdrop(BASE, key), failures)
    expect_error("model extra", _mdl(BASE, {"oops": 1}), failures)
    expect_error("conv_weights 9 filters",
                 _mdl(BASE, {"conv_weights": _cw(9, 2, 2), "conv_bias": [0] * 9,
                             "conv_shift": [1] * 9,
                             "dense_weights": [[1] * 9 for _ in range(3)]}),
                 failures)
    expect_ok("conv_weights 8 filters",
              _mdl(BASE, {"conv_weights": _cw(8, 2, 2), "conv_bias": [0] * 8,
                          "conv_shift": [1] * 8,
                          "dense_weights": [[1] * 8 for _ in range(3)]}),
              failures)
    expect_error("conv_weights kernel width",
                 _mdl(BASE, {"conv_weights": _cw(2, 1, 2)}), failures)
    expect_error("conv_weights inner width",
        {"time": 5, "connection": "a", "length": 1, "draw": 1},
        {"time": 4, "connection": "a", "length": 1, "draw": 1}]}), failures)
    expect_ok("packet times equal", _with(BASE, {"packets": [
        {"time": 5, "connection": "a", "length": 1, "draw": 1},
        {"time": 5, "connection": "b", "length": 1, "draw": 1}]}), failures)
    expect_ok("packets 20000", _with(BASE, {
        "packets": [{"time": i, "connection": "a", "length": i % 100,
                     "draw": i % 2} for i in range(20000)],
        "config": dict(BASE["config"], window=1, kernel=1,
                       conv_weights=[[[1, 0, 0, 0]]],
                       conv_bias=[0], conv_shift=[0],
                       dense_weights=[[1], [1], [1]], service=[1, 1, 1])}),
        failures)
    expect_error("packets 20001", _with(BASE, {
        "packets": [{"time": i, "connection": "a", "length": i % 100,
                     "draw": i % 2} for i in range(20001)]}), failures)
